description: The visible tests pass on the fixture; the bug (refunds render as '$-4.50') shows only in the acceptance check, whose argv the writer never sees. run_checks is available, so passing needs a writer that runs it, learns the failing assertion, and fixes the bug before final verification: requires_run_checks wants at least one run_checks call and a first attempt that passed both gates. Contrast hidden-rule-repair, which refuses run_checks to force a repair.
prompt: The acceptance check fails on main although tests/price.test.cjs passes, and nobody wrote down why. You cannot see that check's command: run it with the run_checks tool to find out what fails, then fix the bug in src/price.cjs. Do not change the tests.
routing_text: Find and fix why the acceptance check fails for the price formatter.

rubric: Existing tests are not weakened or changed

checks.name: acceptance
argv: const assert=require('node:assert/strict');const {formatPrice}=require('./src/price.cjs');assert.equal(formatPrice(1999),'$19.99');assert.equal(formatPrice(-450),'-$4.50','house style: a refund puts the minus sign before the currency symbol, so formatPrice(-450) must be "-$4.50"');
